evalCriteria.prompt: Review every route and endpoint in the diff. Score 0 if any changed frontend route that shows account or billing data is rendered outside `ProtectedRoute`, or any changed backend endpoint reads or mutates user data without checking the caller owns it. Cite the file and line.

Check changed configuration (vite config, CORS middleware, headers, environment flags). Score 0 if the diff widens CORS, disables a security header, enables debug output in production, or exposes a dev-only proxy or setting to production. Cite the file and line.

Check `package.json`, `package-lock.json` and `requirements*.txt` in the diff. Score 0 if a dependency is added from an untrusted source, added without a lockfile update, or pinned to a version with a known critical or high vulnerability. Cite the file and line.

Check every place in the diff where text is rendered or passed to a query or command. Score 0 if any changed code uses `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`, `innerHTML`, `eval` or `new Function`, or interpolates external input into a query, command or URL without encoding. Cite the file and line.
Check changed login, token and session code. Score 0 if the diff logs, renders or persists a password or token in a new location, or bypasses the existing auth check. Cite the file and line.

Check changed error-handling paths. Score 0 if a changed path renders a raw error or stack trace to the user, or fails open (shows privileged UI or data) when data is missing or a request fails. Cite the file and line.
